symptoms.symptom: A warning signal sounds and "alarm" lights up.

causes.label: Various causes are possible.
causes.evidence: Bosch manual, page 25: "Various causes are possible."

causes.label: The appliance door is open.
causes.evidence: Bosch manual, page 25: "The appliance door is open."

symptoms.symptom: All temperature displays and "alarm" light up.

causes.label: A sensor is defective.
causes.evidence: Bosch manual, page 25: "A sensor is defective."

symptoms.symptom: A warning tone sounds and the set temperature (freezer compartment) and "alarm" flash.

causes.label: Various causes are possible.
causes.evidence: Bosch manual, page 25: "Various causes are possible."

causes.label: The freezer compartment door is open.
causes.evidence: Bosch manual, page 25: "The freezer compartment door is open."

causes.label: External ventilation openings are covered up.
remedies: Remove any obstructions from in front of the external ventilation openings.
causes.evidence: Bosch manual, page 25: "External ventilation openings are covered up."

causes.label: Large quantities of fresh food have been placed inside.
remedies: Do not exceed the freezing capacity.
causes.evidence: Bosch manual, page 25: "Large quantities of fresh food have been placed inside."

symptoms.symptom: The temperature differs greatly from the setting.

causes.label: Various causes are possible.
remedies: Switch the appliance back on after approximately
5 minutes. Page 15 If the temperature is too warm, check the temperature again after a couple of hours.
If the temperature is too cold, check the temperature again on the following day.
causes.evidence: Bosch manual, page 25: "Various causes are possible."

symptoms.symptom: The set temperature is not reached. Fully automatic defrosting no longer works.

causes.label: The freezer compartment door was open for a long time. The evaporator (refrigeration unit) in the NoFrost system is heavily iced up.
remedies: Store the frozen food well insulated in a cool place.
Disconnect the appliance from the power supply. Unplug the power plug or switch off the circuit breaker in the fuse box.
causes.evidence: Bosch manual, page 25: "The freezer compartment door was open for a long time. The evaporator (refrigeration unit) in the NoFrost system is heavily iced up."
